description: vite's bundler. The npm tarball ships no Rust source, so the git route takes the tagged tree and cross-checks it against the release's own npm provenance attestation (the packument carries no gitHead). One cdylib, rolldown_binding, standing in for @rolldown/binding-linux-x64-{gnu,musl}. Versions: npm 0.1.0-0.3.0 (2017-2019) are an unrelated earlier package with no binding and no optionalDependencies (min 0.9.1, the first rolldown release with bindings). 0.9.1 and 0.9.2 have no v<version> tag upstream, and 0.10.0 publishes no provenance attestation, so the git route with attestation provenance refuses them; those are denied. Profile: upstream's wasm build is the release-wasi profile (opt-level s over release) with panic=abort from its wasm32 target, and napi's post-link drops the name section as the release profile's strip=symbols does; opt-level z, not s, because instrumented 1.2.11 measured 21.5 MB at z against 26.5 MB at s.
